_comment: Container-exact seccomp profile: only this workload's measured runtime syscalls. The loader/init startup set (mprotect, brk, getrandom, ...) is supplied by ujail's linker/init phase bases and revoked at main, so it is not listed here. Derived by running the image under 'ujail -m complain' and collecting the app-phase syscalls; extend via CONTAINER_SECCOMP_ALLOW or by re-deriving if a code path is missed. defaultAction ERRNO: anything not listed returns EPERM.
